newsitem.title: SPAIN: MOTOR RACING-FRUSTRATION FOR HILL AND SCHUMACHER.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-FRUSTRATION FOR HILL AND SCHUMACHER.

text.p: Formula One world champion Briton Damon Hill and rival German Michael Schumacher both endured a frustrating time on Tuesday when mechanical problems cut short their Formula One testing.

Hill, who had been hoping for the first serious run in his new TWR Arrows car after a clutch sensor failure on Monday, managed to complete only a few laps before being sidelined in the pits by a suspected gearbox problem.
But his exit was far less spectacular than that of Schumacher whose Ferrari suffered the fourth major engine failure since the launch of the new F310B at Fiorano earlier this month.
The double world champion was attempting a long run in the car when the problem caused him to spin onto the grass alongside the main straight and the rear of the car quickly caught fire.

Although he escaped unhurt, and the car was only slightly damaged, it will hardly have impressed Schumacher who reportedly hinted to Ferrari bosses this week he is not entirely satisfied with the overall performance of his new car.
